The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The truck's cab pulls further around the corner while its trailer starts to swing wide toward the front of the ego lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Ego vehicle judges only the cab's path and accelerates forward, moving into the trailer's swing zone without stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car is stopped in the right lane at a bright, clear-daytime city intersection while a long red-cab, white-trailer semi in the adjacent lane begins a tight right turn. By 0:01 the truck's cab angles right and pulls into the corner. From 0:01 to 0:03 the trailer lags then swings wide, its arc sweeping toward the front of the ego lane. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle, judging only the cab's clear path, accelerates forward without stopping and moves into the trailer's swing zone, entering a hazardous conflict as the trailer continues its wide sweep across the front. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
